notes.title: The Free Roam Mode Update: Discover Albatroz Your Way!
notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to introduce one of the most requested features from the community: [b]Free Roam Mode[/b]!
This new mode is designed for those who want to focus on exploration and story without the pressure of survival mechanics.[/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who asked for this — and especially to [b]MySoulToTake[/b], who not only shared valuable feedback but also reminded us of a critical issue just minutes before release (you saved the day!)[/p][p][/p][p]Other than that, we’re also releasing more [b]fixes, optimizations, and polish[/b], as usual.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Free roam mode[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560387/1606e248c147e2b88750fb47d69b3f0c99ead9fd.png"][/img][/p][p]
 The idea behind this mode is to let you focus on exploration without the RPG mechanics getting in the way.[/p][p][/p][p]Free Roam is perfect for those who want to:[/p][list][*][p]Explore at their own pace[/p][/*][*][p][b]Focus on the narrative[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Discover the path to Albatroz[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hunt for hidden places[/b]
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]In this mode:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]You’ll lose no stats from exploring (feet, arms, hunger and thirsty).
Temperature has little to no effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Car fuel consumption and car damage are minimal.[/p][/*][*][p]Buff items last much longer before wearing off.[/p][/*][*][p]Skills cooldown are minimum
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]However:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Arm stats are still consumed normally.[/p][/*][*][p][b]World damage still applies[/b] — meaning if a rock falls on your head, a strong wind strikes you, an enemy attacks, or you fall from a high place, you’ll still lose health as usual.[/p][/*][*][p]You can switch to Free Roam at the beginning of the game (right after starting your journey) or at any time through the configuration menu.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]⚙️ Optimizations[/h3][list][*][p]Reduced global [b]VRAM usage[/b] by ~150 MB  ( A hurray for 8 GB GPUs )[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]distance shader[/b]: buildings and mountains no longer appear overly dark from afar.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Post-credits log:[/b] The maximum number of regions and clues is now displayed correctly, making it possible to track exactly what’s missing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scene 19 (Serpi/Yotsaken event):[/b] Resolved an issue where players were not being teleported back to Isla after the conversation..[/p][/*][*][p][b]Environment:[/b] Removed a rock blocking the middle of a bridge in the last city (seriously, how did nobody report that until now? ).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scene 18 (car chase):[/b] fixed collision issues causing the car to float.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scene 19:[/b] fixed disappearing ground bug that made players fall through the world.[/p][/*][*][p]Various [b]minor fixes and optimizations[/b] across the game.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you all for your continued support and feedback.[/p][p]Once more thank you very much [b]MySoulToTake, [/b]hope you have fun with the free roam![/p][p][/p][p] Enjoy Alba in [b]Free Roam Mode[/b], and as always, if you don't like anything, or like it, please let us know.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Patch 14 - End game patch
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone!
 Besides the addition of PS5 controller support, this update mainly focuses on the endgame — specifically [b]Scene 18[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560387/751d88a7e301d36d2e1fca29d3a439ee3b2f0a5f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Scene 18 is pretty close to the end, and honestly, it doesn’t need to be [i]that[/i] hard. The difficulty was messing a bit with the pacing, so we’ve made a few tweaks to smooth things out. That said, if you still find Scene 18 too tough after the update, feel free to switch the difficulty to [b]"Backpacking with Luxury"[/b] — we won’t judge 😄[/p][p]If you run into any other issues or need anything from us, just reach out![/p][p][/p][h3]🛠️ [b]Patch Notes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]PS5 controller now supported on Steam[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Scene 16:[/b] Improved star-following mechanic and visuals[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scene 16 (Chenen Tower):[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimized VRAM usage[/p][/*][*][p]Added more lore about Chenen[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Performance:[/b] Minor optimizations in Scenes 10, 11 (mountains), 12 (salt desert), and Scenes 16, 17, and 18[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scene 18 (Endgame Tweaks):[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the size and force of falling rocks[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted car damage balance[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked gasoline consumption[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the “Unstuck” system with safer spawn locations[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced problematic ground collisions to prevent wild physics (no more surprise car launches 😅)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased surface friction to reduce sliding[/p][/*][*][p]Weather is now more open and navigable[/p][/*][*][p]Added new “Unstuck” spawn points[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]General:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Minor UI updates[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Minor performance improvements[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]As always, if you run into anything weird or need help, just give us a shout. Happy travels![/p]

notes.title: Albatroz - Patch #13
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We’re excited to announce that [b]Patch #13[/b] for [b][i]Albatroz[/i][/b] is now live on [b]Steam[/b]! This update smooths the path for your journey through The Forbidden Lands, with a reworked save/load system, refined gameplay, and various fixes to keep your adventure on course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560387/3bb463a06eaa030a38490c7cdb3affd8bd373f7a.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your continued support! We hope you enjoy the update, and don’t worry—there’s more on the way. Don't forget to check the patch notes below for all the details.

[h2]Albatroz Patch #13 (Steam):[/h2]

[list]
[*] Post-Credits Scene: Fixed an issue where the maximum number of clues was not displaying correctly.
[*] Save/Load System: Fixed missing game image and text when the save file’s region or location couldn't be found.
[*] Save Slot Improvements: Added default textures and names for save slots with unidentified area IDs (previously displayed as "None" with a blank texture).
[*] Character Issues:
[list]
[*]Isla no longer disappears when pressing the "V" key during conversations with NPCs.
[*]Fixed an issue where Isla's backpack was missing after completing the distortion and returning to Lago Village.
[/list]
[*] Map & UI Fixes:
[list]
[*]Added missing map legends.
[*]Fixed unnecessary 'Confirm' and 'Cancel' buttons appearing in certain settings within the configuration menu.
[/list]
[*] Environmental Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed missing textures and collisions on stones in the snowy region.
[*]Resolved collision issues with rocks while climbing in Last Village.
[*]Fixed missing collision behind the hotel in El Condor.
[*]Fixed floating rocks seen when descending the Grand Wall.
[*]Addressed back-face culling issues and visible rock edges in Scene 17 – Sence Adventure.
[*]Resolved clipping issues when climbing the mountain near the giant tree.
[*]Fixed levitating rock while traveling towards the Sacred Place in Scene 08.
[*]The camp's bed no longer clips into the mountain when placed on Crying Mountain Trail.
[/list]
[*] Gameplay Fixes:
[list]
[*]The player no longer gets stuck after jumping on Romero's brother's head in El Condor Village.
[*]Fixed a softlock where the game would freeze if the player pressed "Switch Party Member" after reaching the village in Scene 1.
[/list]
[*] End Credits: Fixed multiple errors.
[*] General Fixes & Polishing:
[list]
[*]Fixed various corrupted collisions throughout the game.
[*]Minor bug fixes, polish, and overall adjustments.
[*]Small optimizations
[/list]
[*] Save/Load System: Re-worked on the save and load interface to  improve usability and overall design to look better.
[/list]

Thanks,
-Among Giants & SOEDESCO

notes.title: Albatroz - Patch #12
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

We’re happy to let you know that Albatroz Patch V12 has landed on Steam! This update brings fresh improvements and critical fixes to ensure your adventures are as enjoyable as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560387/7949b17bade2f0c07c22f2eb61f064060d5a0302.jpg[/img]

As always, we appreciate your support. Don’t forget to check out the full patch notes below for all the details, and keep an eye out for more updates coming soon!

[b]Performance Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved performance in salt desert and in the mountains using HLODs on the rocks: This is a significant optimization. HLODs (Hierarchical Level of Detail) reduce the number of polygons rendered for distant objects, improving frame rates, especially in graphically demanding environments like deserts and mountains.
[/list]

[b]Level/Scene Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] New path on scene 15 so the player has more options to complete the level.
[*] Fixed corrupted collision on scene 14, going down the hole: This addresses a gameplay-blocking bug where players might get stuck or fall through the world due to incorrect collision.
[*] Fixed a death dialogue that was wrong in scene 14: Corrects an error in the game's dialogue related to player death in this specific scene.
[*] Fixed the death trigger in scene 15 to kill the player if he falls from the world: Prevents players from exploiting falling out of the map and ensures a proper game over.
[*] Fixed gaps on scene 15, on the nameless realm where the player could fall in the world: Patches holes in the game world geometry, preventing unintended falls and softlocks.
[*] Added a new path on scene 15 so the player has more options to complete the level: Improves level design by offering alternative routes, enhancing replayability and player choice.
[*] Fixed some broken shaders in scene 15: Corrects visual glitches related to how materials are rendered in this scene.
[/list]

[b]Localization:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed some localization issues: Addresses errors in translated text, improving the experience for players using different languages.
[/list]

[b]UI/Save/Load Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed missing picture issue on the loading/saving game page, when the game was not able to find the region the player is: Corrects a visual bug on the save/load screen when the game couldn't determine the player's location.
[*] Fixed a missing name on the loading and saving game page when the game was not able to find where the player is: Addresses a similar issue to the above, but related to missing text instead of a picture.
[*] Fixed an issue that the load and save page would return invalid, if just Isla was in the party: Fixes a specific bug that caused save/load issues when the player's party consisted only of the character "Isla."
[/list]

notes.title: Albatroz - Patch #11
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We're thrilled to announce that [i]Albatroz[/i] [b]Patch 11[/b] is now live on [b]Steam[/b]! This update follows our recent content pack release and introduces exciting improvements and fixes to issues blocking your adventures.

In this update, Scene 15 has been improved, providing players with more options to escape the Realm of the Nameless. Additionally, we've resolved some rare issues, including the black screen that appeared after death and fixes for the moving platform that frequently failed to operate. Alongside these changes, we've made various minor fixes for a smoother overall experience. 

Once again, thank you for your continued support! Stay tuned for more updates across all platforms, and check the patch notes below for all the details.

[h3]Albatroz Patch #11 (Steam):[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed Black Screen After Death[/b]
Fixed a rare issue where the screen would sometimes turn black after death and not fade out properly. The transition now works as expected, providing a smoother experience.
 
[*] [b]Improved Scene 15 (Distortions)[/b]
Added new paths and options in Scene 15, giving players more ways to escape the Realm of the Nameless. These changes enhance the scene's replayability and strategic choices.
 
[*] [b]Fixed Progression Issue in Scene 15[/b]
Fixed an issue where players could die and still continue playing. Now, death correctly resets progression to ensure proper gameplay flow.
 
[*] [b]Fixed Moving Platform Issue in Scene 15[/b]
Addressed a rare bug where a moving platform would sometimes fail to move. Players can now use alternative paths if the platform doesn’t function as expected.
 
[*] [b]Fixed Initial Tutorial[/b]
Corrected an issue with the game's initial tutorial that caused confusion. The controls and mechanics are now explained more clearly.
 
[*] [b]Other Minor Fixes and Polish[/b]
Various minor fixes and improvements across the game, including performance optimizations and interface tweaks for a smoother experience
[/list]

Thanks,
-Among Giants & SOEDESCO

notes.title: Albatroz First Content Pack
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560387/a8b17a7ab4adabc308ec06c3e2b271787d6d1435.jpg[/img]

Hey, everyone!

We're so excited to announce that the [b]First Content Pack [/b]for [b][i]Albatroz [/i][/b]has officially launched today on Steam! This release is filled with incredible new features, enhancements, and fixes to make your journey with Isla and her crew even more epic.

In the first content pack, we’ve completely revamped the save system, giving you up to [b]100 save slots[/b]. We've also [b]rebalanced TP Costs[/b] and addressed cutscene issues on Steam Deck. For our backpackers on low-end PCs, video playback has been optimized so you can embark on this adventure without compromise. This content pack also includes numerous other fixes and improvements to refine your overall [i]Albatroz [/i]experience.

Check out all the details below:

[h1]Albatroz First Content Pack:[/h1]

[h3]New Features[/h3]

[b]Enhanced Save System[/b]

We’ve completely overhauled the save system, introducing save slots to give players more flexibility in managing their progress. 

Here’s what’s new: Players can now use up to [b]100 save slots[/b] to capture different moments in their journey.
[list]
[*] A new auto-save feature creates saves at critical locations and near save points.
[*] You can load any save slot from within the game or the main menu.
[*] Save slots can be deleted individually for better organization.
[*] Backward compatibility: Your old save files are still supported.
[*] Each save slot now displays detailed information about your progress, including party members, current weather, total clues, travel points (TP), and more — a total of 14 key metrics. Previously, this information was only available after the credits.
[*] The “Continue” option now smartly resumes the most recent save.
[*] Now the load game should be faster
[/list]

This upgrade was a significant effort for the team, and we’re thrilled with the results. 

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] [i]Please back up your old save files before updating. If you encounter any issues with your saves, don’t hesitate to reach out.
[/i]
[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced TP Costs: Adjusted the costs for unlocking primary and secondary skills to improve progression.
[*] Steam Deck Compatibility: Fixed an issue where cutscenes weren’t playing and showed a black screen instead.
[*] Improved Scene 17 Sequence: Refined the “Serpi Playing” sequence, adding some objects to better communicate Isla’s actions and enhance the post-credits scene.
[*] Optimized Video Playback for Low-End PCs: Players using resolutions below 1920x1080 will now experience smoother playback with Full HD videos using the AV1 codec.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a critical issue where a save point in forbidden lands was corrupted.
[*] Loading Warning: Added a notification when the character is floating waiting for the level to load.
[*] Particle Effects: Enhanced smoke visuals for a more immersive experience.
[*] Scene Updates: Refined events in Scene 19 and further improved the “Serpi Playing” sequence in Scene 17.
[*] Shader Fixes: Resolved issues with Albatroz’s giant eye
[*] Fixed shader and the Flashlight 3 shader.
[*] Small adjustments and improvements
[/list]

Once again, thank you for your ongoing support and dedication to [i]Albatroz[/i]. For any remaining issues that didn’t make it into this update, rest assured they’re on our radar. Stay tuned as more exciting content and updates are coming your way soon!

Thanks,

-Among Giants & SOEDESCO

notes.title: Albatroz - Patch #5
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, everyone![/h2]

We’re excited to bring you the latest update for[b][i] Albatroz[/i][/b], Patch #5, now live on Steam. This update includes a range of new additions and enhancements to improve your experience as you navigate the challenging terrain of the Forbidden Lands.

In this patch, we've added more comprehensive tutorials to help players better understand the mechanics. We’ve also fixed save issues in Scene 13 and reduced the distance between checkpoints on the Death Road in the snow area. Additionally, we’ve made various fixes to improve the overall gameplay experience.

We appreciate your ongoing support and feedback, and we hope these updates make your time in [i]Albatroz[/i] even more enjoyable. Check out the patch notes below for all the details:

[b][h3]Albatroz Patch #5 (Steam):[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Added more tutorials to remind players that colder conditions increase hunger consumption, while warmer conditions increase thirst.
[*] Introduced additional tutorials to better explain game systems.
[*] Fixed a critical issue in the coastal region where players couldn't progress if they missed the Serpi camp.
[*] Added a secondary collision layer during region transitions to support slower hard drives, ensuring smoother level loading.
[*] Corrected a bug where the interactable Carranca in Lago Village showed Isla’s name during conversations, even though it was Sence speaking.
[*] Resolved an issue where fireflies in Scene 15 (inside the hole) would stop glowing.
[*] Fixed a bug in Scene 15 where Isla would remain in her pajamas for the rest of the game if the player didn’t change her clothes.
[*] Enhanced the mountains in the coastal region for a more natural look and to prevent boundary-breaking.
[*] Improved the shadow-chasing sequence in Scene 3.
[*] Fixed collision issues that could trap players.
[*] Increased the chance of clear weather in Lago Village.
[*] Adjusted text on signs to prevent it from overflowing outside the signs.
[*] Fixed a save game issue in Scene 13 that allowed players to remain in first-person view even outside houses.
[*] Resolved a bug where a floating Sence would appear during the planning phase.
[*] Fixed an issue in Scene 14 where both a duplicated Sence and Serpi could appear inside the temple.
[*] Increased the chances of clear weather in Scene 6.
[*] Improved tutorial prompts to appear at more appropriate moments.
[*] Ensured the weather clears up when using the telescope at Gelya’s house.
[*] Adjusted the TP gain sound to a lower, more balanced level.
[*] Fixed missing collisions on rocks in the coastal region.
[*] Improved the start of the trail into the Mist Lands in Scene 12, making it easier to locate.
[*] Shortened the checkpoint distance on the Death Road in the snow region.
[*] Resolved floating pyramid issues in the coastal region.
[*] Implemented numerous minor fixes and general polish throughout the game.
[/list]

Thanks,
-Among Giants & SOEDESCO

notes.title: Albatroz - Patch #4
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, everyone![/h2]

The weekend is almost here, but before you kick back, we've got some exciting news for our [b][i]Albatroz[/i][/b] PC players. The latest update, [b]Patch #4[/b], is now live on[b] Steam[/b]! This update brings a host of enhancements, tweaks, and fixes designed to make your journey through the Forbidden Lands smoother and more manageable.

Thank you for your ongoing support. More updates are on the way, so keep an eye out!  

Check out the patch notes below for the full details.

[h3]Albatroz Patch #4:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player would turn transparent while sleeping.
[*] Corrected the "Point of No Return" message, which was not appearing when exiting the Forbidden Lands.
[*] Enhanced the Forbidden Lands level with improved visuals and gameplay adjustments.
[*] Improved the dynamic weather transitions in the Forbidden Lands. The weather will be more clear on this region. 
[*] Increased the difficulty of the trail "Path Till the Hole" in Scene 14 (Forest).
[*] Fixed an issue where the player continued losing health during the transition questions between biomes.
[*] Added gasoline in the coastal region before the tides sequence to aid progression.
[*] Fixed an issue where two sences appeared during the Scene 8 sequence with the Forbidden Lands Gatekeeper.
[*] Enhanced the "Goodbye El Condor" sequence in Scene 7, refining the farewell moment with Isla and Sence.
[*] Fixed a bug in Scene 9 where Isla could be duplicated if the player tried to sleep at a camp while her ankle was injured near the fire.
[*] Toned down the intensity of Gelya's voice in dialogue to make it less exaggerated.
[*] Fixed an issue where the screen would fade out after death but fail to fade back in.
[*] Resolved a bug where the low-health effect sometimes wouldn't dissipate after recovery.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game occasionally failed to register death, making the player immortal.
[*] Corrected the "Point of No Return" message, which was not appearing when exiting the Forgotten valley.
[*] Various minor fixes, polishments and quality of life improvements.
[*] Fixed a critical issue where sometimes the blocker would fail to block the player, making it possible to break game levels and events.
[/list]

Thanks,
-Among Giants & SOEDESCO

notes.title: Patch 3 - PC
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where, sometimes after scene 2, the player would be teleported back to scene 1.

- Fixed an issue where talking with the Forbidden Lands guardian would spawn a sequence with Sence in the party, even if she hadn’t joined the party yet.

- Improved the "blocker" when hitting it with the car. The blocker is the tool that teleports you back to the road. Now the car should be placed in the correct position without causing a collision break.

-Improved the death road in the ice mountain scenery.

- Improved the death road in the ice mountain area to prevent it from "locking" the player.

- Fixed an issue in the ice region where two music tracks could play at the same time.

-Increased the chances of clear weather in the mountains.

- Decreased the difficulty of scene 18 (the chase).

- Fixed an issue in scene 18 where the chase would never start.

- Improved the overall chase experience in scene 18 by smoothing the level.

-  Fixed a bug where, if the player threw the car into a hole or lake and exited in mid-air, they would lose input control if trying to enter the vehicle afterward.

- Fixed a bug where the character would appear to be flying after loading the game and would only land on the ground after a delay, restoring player control.

- Increased the distance required to be defeated during the chase in Scene 18.

- Fixed an issue in Scene 14 where background music was playing incorrectly.

- Improved collision handling when descending into the hole in Scene 14.
Fixed an issue in Scene 15 where the monster sequence could play multiple times.

- Adjusted the likelihood of "partially cloudy" weather in Scene 18 (the chase) to improve visibility.

- Added additional explanation about Serpi’s protection skill.

- Added further details on how resting restores health and revives characters.
Enhanced events and level design in Scene 3 when the player is chasing the shadow.

- Added extra collisions in Scene 12 to prevent the player from falling into the lake when teleporting to the bridge.

- Improved level design and events in Scene 13 for better communication and flow.

- Fixed a bug in Scene 14 where going into the hole would reload Scene 13, causing the Loiji sequence to play again.

- Fixed an issue in Scene 15 where unintended rain or snow could appear in the Nameless Realm.

- In Scene 15, all magazines and books were changed to white to avoid confusion with a specific magazine.

- Fixed a bug in Scene 9 where, when Isla hurt her feet, if the player returned to the car, there would be two Islas in the party.

- Decreased the time the flashback reward stays on screen.

- Fixed a bug where the player could sleep while the monster appeared in Scene 3.

notes.title: Patch 2 - Balance and Stability Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560387/edd78b3d4d92780587d01b83f39bfe9d894513ba.jpg[/img]

- Rebalanced the amount of TP required to buy new stats. Health, legs, and arms are now more expensive, while hunger and thirst are cheaper.

- A bug that would teleport you back in the "death road" in the ice mountain.

- Fixed an issue where car lanterns wouldn’t repair when attempting to fix the car.

- Optimized memory usage in scenes 4, 5, 6, and 7.

- Fixed an issue where the ritual puzzle couldn’t be completed in some cases.

- Fixed max number values in the post-credits list.

- Fixed several places where you could fall through the terrain.

- Decreased the probability of rain.

- Fixed an issue where the camping skill sometimes didn’t work.

- Fixed an issue where you could die by jumping into the sea while naked.

- Added a timer in scene 15 inside the hole that advances the scene if the player fails.

- Added more landmarks at Serpi Camp in the coastal region to make it easier to find.

- Reduced glow in some areas.

- Increased the amount of gasoline gained when finding the Beverage Liquor item.

- Reduced car damage in certain parts.

- Fixed an issue where the character would die right at the start of the "Sense Quest" in scene 17.

- The car can now take more damage overall.

- Added a reminder in the snow and coastal regions if the player loses Serpi Hut.

- Decreased the mass of "falling rocks" to prevent the car from getting stuck under the terrain.

- If the player falls through the terrain in scene 18, they will be teleported back to a safe location.

- Fixed an issue where the player could fall out of the world in scene 19 (Ice Cavern).

- Fixed an issue where the game could be completed by playing with "Sense" only.

- Improved the inverted Y and X axis options for controllers.

notes.title: First week patch - Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a rare bug where the player could get stuck on a black screen after entering Lago Village.

- Switched the snow and mountain areas names on the coastal region map for improved accuracy.

- Improved car menu controller  usability to make skill selection easier.

- Added more foliage along the “Hole” trail in Scene 14.

- The spawner tool now reduces spawn rate while driving to improve performance.

- Rebalanced gasoline consumption for smoother gameplay.

- Fixed an issue where gasoline could run out despite fuel being in the tank.

- Added total gameplay hours to the player checklist in the post-credits.

- Improved some performance across various maps.

- Minor bug fixes for enhanced gameplay stability.
